items.title: Tesla reportedly considering a spin off of its China business
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is reportedly considering a spin-off of its China business, according to the Wall Street Journal. This comes amid murmurs of a possible merger between the EV maker and Elon Musk's space venture SpaceX (SPCX).

items.title: Combining Tesla and SpaceX Makes 'A Ton of Sense' Says Munster
items.summary: Tesla Inc. is weighing a potential separation of its China business to pave the way for a possible merger with SpaceX, according to the Wall Street Journal. Separating Tesla's China operations would be a complex undertaking due to the auto factory's deep embedding in China's electric vehicle supply chain and its role in supplying vehicles to markets worldwide. Gene Munster, Managing Partner at Deepwater Asset Management, joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss Tesla as well as to break down Apple's earnings.
